translation_notes: outer subjects(RDFS.domain, cls) is a single-motif m{ ?prop rdfs:domain {cls} }; the isinstance(prop, URIRef) filter is kept verbatim since a plain m{ } can bind a blank node too.

range/label/comment are three g.value() lookups on the same prop, each independently guarded (config.include_labels, config.include_descriptions) and each tolerant of absence -- per prior trav_navigation findings, folding them into one multi-pattern m{ } would turn the missing-value case into a dropped row instead of a None, so each stays its own m{ }.first().
context shim (shacl_context.py) reconstructs PropertyConstraint, ShaclConfig and DomainRangeConverter._is_datatype/XSD_DATATYPES from the upstream source at the pinned commit.

repair.driver: four calls added: ex:Person with both config flags False, with only include_labels, with only include_descriptions, and ex:Place (no property, zero solutions); fixture adds an empty label and comment, a range declared rdfs:Datatype outside XSD, a property with two labels, and neighbours sharing two terms of a motif under rdfs:seeAlso

optimization_notes: optimized.py: nothing to compress; it is original.py unchanged. Each step (URIRef filter, guarded range/label/comment lookups that leave the default on a falsy value) is already one statement, and the nested range test is shorter than its elif form.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: no island survives rule 4. Each `m{ {prop} rdfs:P ?v }.first()` is two tokens longer than `source_graph.value(prop, rdfs:P)`, and `m{ ?prop rdfs:domain {cls} }` plus the `@graph source_graph` it needs is one token longer than `source_graph.subjects(rdfs:domain, cls)` (measured). What is left of the notation is the prefixed names in place of `RDFS.x` in the four calls; the ratio above 1 is the header's three @prefix lines.
No exception to the symmetry. The three value lookups are not fused into one join: each is optional, and a join would drop the property when one is missing.
header_optimization_notes: Python: BNode, Literal, Namespace, RDF, XSD and ConverterSelf go (ShaclConfig stays, named in the string annotation of config).
LD Python: the same, plus RDFS; @prefix rdf: and xsd: go, rdfs: stays.
